title: Mini engines through the years
author: Caramagnols
excerpt: The classic Mini lived around the A-Series engine, with capacities and outputs changing while the compact layout remained.
content:
The classic Mini's engine story is mainly the story of the A-Series in different forms. The first cars used an 848 cc unit; later versions received other capacities and states of tune according to period, market and model.

Practical final checks

The technical layout is explained in the Mini's engineering choices. The Cooper path begins with the birth of the Mini Cooper.

Sources

  • BMW Group PressClub, Classic Mini Timeline: 1959 - 2000
  • National Motor Museum, Austin Mini Seven
  • BMW Group PressClub, 1959 - 2019. Sixty Years of MINI
